description: Ledger of the restore drills of the whole installation (HSKT YCK.06: periodic restore test with evidence). One entry per drill, oldest first, appended in the commit that signs the minutes; an entry is never edited or removed (a wrong entry is answered by a new entry that names it in `corrects`). Fields come from the output of scripts/restore-drill.mjs compare. scripts/backup-verify.mjs checks the structure offline and `drill-status` judges the age against restoreDrill.maxDaysBetweenDrills of backup-policy.json.
